recognize_zh: A 圖是慢性期 CML 樣抹片：各階段顆粒球（骨髓細胞、帶狀核、分葉核）加上深紫色粗顆粒的嗜鹼性球；B 圖則出現大量含粗大深紫嗜鹼性顆粒的未成熟細胞與淡藍細胞質的芽細胞（插圖），提示嗜鹼性芽細胞期。
features: Panel A: full spectrum of granulocytic maturation (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands, segmented neutrophils) with several basophils containing coarse dark granules
Panel B: numerous immature cells with round nuclei, fine to moderately condensed chromatin and coarse purple-black basophilic granules obscuring the nucleus
Panel B: blasts with high N:C ratio and deeply basophilic agranular or sparsely granular cytoplasm (inset)
Scattered extracellular metachromatic granules from degranulated basophils in panel B background
Red cells relatively normocytic with scattered platelets
describe_en: Composite blood/marrow smears (Wright-Giemsa). Panel A shows marked granulocytic proliferation with a full maturation spectrum, including myelocytes and basophils, typical of chronic-phase chronic myeloid leukemia. Panel B shows numerous immature basophilic cells with coarse dark granules together with blasts having high N:C ratio and deeply basophilic cytoplasm (inset), with scattered free basophilic granules in the background. Findings are consistent with basophilic blast phase of CML; blast enumeration, flow cytometry (CD123, CD203c, CD25) and toluidine blue staining help confirm basophilic lineage.

ddx.vs: Basophils are mature with segmented nuclei and blasts remain below the blast-phase threshold (typically <20%).
Morphology is similar but there is no preceding CML history and no BCR-ABL1 fusion.
Mast cells have oval nuclei, abundant cytoplasm with evenly dispersed metachromatic granules, and express CD117 and tryptase strongly without basophil markers such as CD123/CD203c-high with 2D7.
APL promyelocytes have bilobed nuclei with coarse azurophilic (red-purple) granules and Auer rod bundles, and are strongly MPO positive with PML-RARA.
